instruction: Look at gui_007_pipe_elbow.step in SolidWorks, a 90 degree pipe elbow with outer diameter 30 mm, inner diameter 20 mm, centerline radius 45 mm, and flat ends. The elbow centerline lies in the XZ plane with one end centered at (0,0,0) normal to Z and the other end centered at (0,0,90) normal to X. Add one circular flange to each pipe end. Each flange must have outside diameter 58 mm, thickness 8 mm, a center hole matching the 20 mm pipe inner diameter, and four equally spaced through bolt holes of diameter 6 mm on radius 22 mm. Place the Z-normal flange from Z=-8 to Z=0, and place the X-normal flange from X=0 to X=8. The flanges must be coaxial with the elbow ends. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\gui_007_elbow_flanges_out.step as either a single multi-body STEP or an assembly STEP.
